component.name: ProofMark
component.summary: Darkroom contact-sheet proofing with wax grease-pencil marks

description.p: ProofMark lays out a roll of film scans as a contact sheet with simulated emulsion rebate and lets you mark it up the way you would in the darkroom, with a wax grease pencil.

ul.li: Star picks, rejects, exposure push and pull, crop boxes, rings, arrows and lines
Hover loupe with magnification and side-by-side compare
Film, camera and lens inventory with favorites
One-click clean print and PDF export of the contact sheet
XMP and EXIF sidecar sync, RAW support
Crop and ring boxes with resize handles, Adjust tool, version tracking, print and PDF export, settings
